Hi Laura / team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, we want to keep the onboarding lightweight while ensuring your auditors can map CAIQ/SIG questions to concrete SOC 2 artifacts. Attached is a short inventory (SOC2_Artifacts_List.xlsx) that maps typical CAIQ control families to the artifacts we can provide from our portals (Vendr + OneTrust export).

Two proposals for evidence channeling so you can choose what fits BetaHealth's audit model:
- Staged channeling (preferred): Redwood uploads canonical artifacts to a customer-scoped Vendr profile. We provide signed manifests, a timestamped bucket reference, and a short CAIQ -> SOC2 mapping table you can export. TTL for staged artifacts: 90 days after the last upload unless you request archival.
- Direct delivery: We push a signed evidence bundle (zip + manifest) to an SFTP endpoint you manage. TTL for delivered bundles is governed by your retention policies.

Questions for you:
1) Which channel do you prefer for the initial SOC 2 evidence?
2) Do you need us to preserve artifacts beyond 90 days for your internal retention?
3) Any special requirements for proof-of-possession (e.g., KMS-signed hashes)?

Next steps if staged channeling is OK: we will provision a Vendr profile, upload the initial asset set, and provide a runbook for how BetaHealth reviewers can pull CAIQ-aligned exports. I attached a short runbook draft (portal_runbook_v1.pdf) — please review.

Good questions — quick answers: 
- Export links: Yes. For staged channeling we can enable time-limited, signed export links (configurable TTL) so BetaHealth reviewers can pull archives without a new Vendr account. We will also provide an audit log of link generation.
- Retention exceptions: We can support extended retention up to 12 months with an authorization ticket (we keep a signed approval record in the profile metadata). I'll flag this as an "extended-retention" request in the runbook template.
- KMS-signed hashes: We support attaching SHA256 + KMS signature metadata to each artifact manifest; we will include that in the first upload so your auditors can verify proof-of-possession.

If that all sounds good I propose we:
1) Start with staged channeling + 6 month retention (interim) so you can validate the exports;
2) We provision the Vendr profile and upload the initial SOC2 artifacts within 48 business hours of your go-ahead;
3) BetaHealth returns a short retention exception form if you want 12 months.

Action requested: please confirm staged channeling + six-month interim retention and send the SFTP details only if you prefer direct delivery.
